messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.14-0 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
Main changes (for more, please see the NEWS file):

o function 'gridSearch' was added (experimental)

o directory NMOFex was added. It contains the code for 'Examples and
Extensions for the NMOF package'; the pdf-version of the report is available
from  
http://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=895233


... and, finally, 'Numerical Methods and Optimization in Finance' by M.
Gilli, D.Maringer and E. Schumann is now available in print
